title: Pusyanug Churna
description: Pusyanug Churna (Pushyanuga Churna) is a legendary classical formula collected during the Pushya star alignment, containing potent astringent herbs with ancient significance. This formulation is the premier treatment for uterine disorders including various gynecological conditions. Addresses excessive bleeding through hemostatic action. Manages irregular cycles by balancing female hormones. Treats ovarian cysts through tissue-normalizing action. Manages bleeding piles through astringent action.
dosage: Mixed with honey followed by rice water
